item.title: Version 0.1.22
item.description:
RunBar 0.1.22 — small polish.
• Victory state in the popover, the onboarding Done step and the TrackView now bounces vertically on top of the frame cycle, so the figure reads as airborne — same fix that was already on the marketing site. • New "Buy me a gel" button in Settings → About, opens Ko-fi in your default browser. Same support link is now in the website footer too. Free and MIT-licensed; gels are optional fuel for the project. • Settings → About now reads the bundled version dynamically instead of the hard-coded "0.1.0" placeholder it had been showing forever.
